g.text: Pair 80 · same segments at each depth
Pair 100 · same segments at each depth
Stars at depth zero: smoothed IR surface estimates (USurf.usurffilt), 9.87 cm/s for pair 80 and 13.49 cm/s for pair 100.
Raw fresh-dot values are absent at the matched times. The stored filtered series interpolates gaps and uses a 40-sample moving mean (~0.93 s).
Original subsurface curves are unchanged. Each red/blue pair uses identical intervals at each depth; the available intervals vary with depth.
Gray = previously masked strip; prior local-depth geometry is retained. Surface velocity is not converted into an integral without a supported surface width.
